recognize_zh: 成群的中型母細胞，核圓、染色質均勻細緻、核仁不明顯，細胞質極少、無顆粒，形態一致；周邊可見殘存的顆粒球系細胞與破碎細胞，符合前驅 B 細胞淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round nuclei with fine, evenly dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous or faint
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Residual maturing granulocytes and smudged cells at the periphery; scattered red cells
describe_en: The smear shows clusters of monotonous small-to-medium blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Auer rods and granules are not seen. Residual maturing granulocytes and smudged cells are present at the periphery. The morphology favors lymphoblasts, and findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia pending immunophenotypic confirmation (CD19, CD10, CD22, TdT, CD34) and cytogenetic/molecular risk stratification.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts are MPO/Sudan black positive in >=3% and may contain Auer rods, whereas lymphoblasts are MPO-negative.
T-ALL is cytoplasmic CD3-positive and B-lineage-negative, often with a mediastinal mass.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles, surface Ig and are TdT-negative with MYC rearrangement.
Hematogones are smaller with more condensed chromatin and show a normal maturation continuum by flow cytometry.
